subject.title: Respect work days for Codex pace

question: Should selecting 4, 5, or 7 work days fully replace Codex historical predictions, or should the historical evaluator itself become work-day-aware?
rationale: Both approaches address the report but produce materially different pace and run-out semantics for users with accumulated history.

options.title: Explicit schedule wins
options.body: Keep the PR’s narrow precedence rule so a selected schedule is authoritative and history is used only in Automatic mode.

options.title: Adapt historical curves
options.body: Keep historical predictions active and redesign the evaluator and stored curves to account for the selected work-day calendar.

recommendation.title: Explicit schedule wins
recommendation.body: Keep the PR’s narrow precedence rule so a selected schedule is authoritative and history is used only in Automatic mode.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history shows this person integrated, hardened, and merged the current historical pace model.
